system.description:
Cast as a spell: duplicates any spell of 8th level or lower, using your caster level and spell DC and ignoring its material components; the duplicated spell's own save applies. Cast as a Ritual (no slot; takes 1 hour; consumes 25,000 gp of components; you gain 2 levels of Exhaustion): shape reality by choosing one effect: raise one attribute of one creature by 1 permanently (once per creature); return a dead creature to life as True Resurrection, with no body or time limit needed; end any curse, disease, affliction, ability loss or Exhaustion; free a creature from Imprisonment, Temporal Stasis, Maze or Trap the Soul; create one nonmagical object worth up to 25,000 gp; or transport up to 8 creatures anywhere on any plane. Any other effect must be approved by the GM before the ritual begins; it cannot kill a creature outright or grant levels, and the GM names its cost up front.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard
